staleVersion: This record was changed in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
notFound: This record no longer exists or is not available to you.
invalid: Some of the entries are not valid. Check them and try again.

reasons.accept_invitation_required: An invited user becomes active by accepting the invitation — resend the invitation instead.
reasons.access_window_closed: Your access to this business is not open at this time ({{window}}).
reasons.accounting_period_closed: The accounting period for this date is closed. Choose a date in an open period.
reasons.already_revoked: This connected account has already been disconnected.
reasons.catalogue_variant_missing: The catalogue variant of this configuration no longer exists.
reasons.category_automatic_only: This category is only ever booked automatically, never by hand.
reasons.coded_field_locked: The coded fields of a catalogue configuration come from the catalogue and cannot be changed.
reasons.coded_field_required: The coded fields of a manual configuration cannot be cleared.
reasons.coded_fields_required: A manual configuration needs all five coded fields.
reasons.colleague_cannot_act_there: The chosen colleague does not work in the business this record belongs to.
reasons.configuration_mode_fixed: The mode of a saved configuration cannot be changed — copy it into a new configuration instead.
reasons.configuration_mode_not_allowed: A configuration of this kind cannot be used here.
reasons.customer_do_not_contact: Customer {{customerNumber}} is marked do-not-contact and cannot be attached to an offer or a contract.
reasons.customer_tag_exists: A tag in this change is already on the customer — the customer changed in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
reasons.discount_suppressed_on_used_vehicle: A per-line discount is suppressed by default on a used vehicle. To grant it anyway, give a reason.
reasons.duplicate_connection: A connection to this provider in this environment already exists.
reasons.email_already_on_customer: This email address is already on this customer.
reasons.external_id_taken: This system already has an external ID on this customer, or this external ID is already used for another customer under the same system.
reasons.invalid_new_price: A best match needs the new price.
reasons.invalid_type_approval_number: A best match needs the Typenschein.
reasons.last_usable_contact_point: A customer keeps at least one usable phone number or email address. Add another one first.
reasons.legacy_sale: This contract was migrated from the legacy system, which handled it there — it cannot be changed here.
reasons.merged_party_row: This row is the copy a customer merge kept; it cannot hold its role again.
reasons.missing_config_fields: This connection is missing required settings: {{fields}}.
reasons.missing_containers: The offer is not complete yet. Missing: {{containers}}.
reasons.missing_price: This contract has no price yet. Complete the price build-up first.
reasons.missing_vehicle: This contract has no vehicle yet. Add a vehicle first.
reasons.no_catalogue_variant: A configuration without a catalogue variant cannot be re-synced.
reasons.no_fields: Choose at least one field to re-sync.
reasons.no_provider_connection: No vehicle data provider is connected.
reasons.no_signed_contract: No signed contract carries this valuation as its trade-in, so it cannot be marked as used: only a signed deal uses a valuation.
reasons.not_active: Only an active user can be suspended.
reasons.nul_character: The entry contains a character that is not allowed. Remove it and try again.
reasons.offer_already_contracted: This offer already has a contract; only a cancelled contract frees an offer.
reasons.passkey_key_not_accepted: This passkey’s key does not meet our security requirements. Use another authenticator.
reasons.passkey_not_verified: The passkey could not be verified. Please try again.
reasons.phone_already_on_customer: This phone number is already on this customer.
reasons.primary_unset_directly: The primary mark cannot be removed directly. Mark another entry as primary instead.
reasons.provider_code_already_mapped: This provider code is already mapped to {{mapping}}.
reasons.too_many_images: A stock vehicle has at most {{max, number}} images. Remove an image first.
reasons.unknown_fields: Some of the chosen specification fields are unknown.
reasons.unrecognised_identifier: The input is not a VIN, a licence plate, a Stammnummer, a Typenschein or a Werkscode.
reasons.use_deactivate_endpoint: A user is deactivated through the deactivation step, which hands over what they still own.
reasons.vehicle_left_stock: This vehicle has already left stock and cannot be reserved.
reasons.vehicle_not_purchased: The vehicle of this contract has not been purchased yet — it can be invoiced once Stock has booked its purchase.
reasons.vin_already_in_stock: This VIN is already in stock as {{stockNumber}}.
reasons.wagenbuch_closed: This vehicle has been sold — its Wagenbuch takes no new entries.
reasons.purchase_requires_vin: This vehicle cannot be purchased without its VIN.
reasons.purchase_vin_mismatch: This VIN is not the VIN of the vehicle in stock.
reasons.brand_code_taken: A brand with this code already exists.
reasons.photo_not_an_image: The photo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
reasons.photo_too_large: The photo is too large — at most 5 MB.
reasons.configuration_already_linked: A configuration is already assigned to this vehicle. Please reload the page.
reasons.configuration_vin_differs: The configuration's VIN is not this vehicle's VIN. The configuration describes another vehicle.
reasons.configuration_held_by_stock_item: This configuration already belongs to vehicle {{stockNumber}} in stock. Every vehicle has its own configuration.
reasons.vehicle_label_follows_configuration: This vehicle's name is its configuration's and follows it. Change the configuration instead.
reasons.ui_translation_blank: A UI string is never blank.
reasons.ui_translation_placeholders_changed: The text must keep the placeholders of the shipped text.
reasons.bank_account_used_by_location: A location uses this account as its own bank account. Remove the override on the location first.
reasons.closure_period_inverted: The closure ends before it starts.
reasons.last_active_location: A business always keeps at least one active location. Activate or create another one first.
reasons.location_address_incomplete: An address needs street, number, postal code and locality.
reasons.location_canton_not_swiss: The canton applies to a Swiss address only.
reasons.location_canton_required: A Swiss address needs its canton.
reasons.location_code_immutable: A location's code is fixed once saved – documents and marketplaces carry it.
reasons.location_code_taken: Another location of this business already has this code.
reasons.location_geo_incomplete: Latitude and longitude go together – enter or clear both.
reasons.location_inactive: Nobody can be newly assigned to a deactivated location.
reasons.location_postal_code_invalid: This postal code does not fit the address's country.
reasons.unknown_bank_account: This bank account does not belong to this business.
reasons.unknown_holiday_calendar: This holiday calendar does not exist.
reasons.year_out_of_range: This year lies outside the calendar.
reasons.logo_format_jpeg: JPEG is not accepted for a logo: it has no transparency, so it prints with a grey box behind it on every document. Upload an SVG (preferred) or a PNG.
reasons.logo_format_unsupported: A logo must be an SVG (preferred) or a PNG file.
reasons.logo_too_small: This PNG is {{width, number}} × {{height, number}} px. A logo printed 50 mm wide needs roughly {{min, number}} px on its long edge to stay sharp at 300 dpi — upload a larger PNG, or an SVG, which is sharp at any size.
reasons.logo_dimensions_too_large: The image is larger than {{max, number}} px on its long edge — more than any document needs.
reasons.logo_file_too_large: The logo file is too large — at most 5 MB.
reasons.logo_png_damaged: The PNG file is damaged and cannot be read.
reasons.logo_svg_invalid: The SVG file is not a well-formed SVG document.
reasons.logo_svg_entities: The SVG declares XML entities, which can be used to attack the systems that read it. Export the logo again without a DTD.
reasons.standard_text_placeholder_unresolved: A standard text contains a placeholder that has no value here ({{placeholders}}). Add the information or adapt the text under Administration › Standard texts.
reasons.standard_text_placeholder_invalid: The text uses placeholders that are not allowed here ({{placeholders}}).
reasons.standard_text_exists: This text already exists in this language. Edit the existing one.
reasons.standard_text_category_mismatch: This text belongs to another category.
reasons.standard_text_code_unknown: This standard text does not exist.
reasons.standard_text_code_target_mismatch: This text is used in another place.
reasons.standard_text_target_unknown: This category has no texts for this use.
reasons.standard_text_slot_unknown: This position does not exist here.
reasons.standard_text_target_required: Choose where and in which position the text is used.
reasons.standard_text_template_whatsapp_only: Template approval applies to WhatsApp texts only.
reasons.standard_text_template_id_required: An approved WhatsApp template needs the provider's template ID.
reasons.standard_text_not_an_override: Only an adapted standard text has a template to review.
reasons.standard_text_seed_language_missing: This template does not exist in this language.
reasons.standard_text_seed_not_shipped: Nexotec ships no text for this seed; there is nothing to restore.
reasons.logo_too_many_pixels: This PNG is {{width, number}} × {{height, number}} px — more than {{max, number}} megapixels. No logo needs that many: a whole A4 page at 300 dpi has barely 9, and every document carrying the logo would have to load them all. Scale the image down, or upload an SVG.
reasons.pending_contract_carries_it: An open contract carries this valuation as its trade-in; its confirmation would use it. Cancel that contract first.
reasons.signed_contract_carries_it: A signed contract carries this valuation as its trade-in, so it stays used.
reasons.stamp_too_recent: This valuation was marked as used less than an hour ago; its contract's confirmation may still be in progress. Please try again later.
reasons.valuation_not_used: This valuation is not marked as used.
reasons.plate_already_on_vehicle: This plate is already recorded on this vehicle for that period.
reasons.plate_canton_invalid: Please choose one of the 26 cantons.
reasons.plate_current_on_other_vehicle: This plate is recorded on another vehicle.
reasons.plate_invalid: A plate is the canton and one to six digits, e.g. ZH 123456.
reasons.plate_move_and_wechselschild: A plate either moves or becomes an interchangeable plate, not both.
reasons.plate_move_before_start: The assignment on the other vehicle starts on the same day or later – please choose a later «Valid from».
reasons.plate_validity_invalid: An assignment cannot end before it starts.
reasons.plate_wechselschild_not_possible: An interchangeable plate joins exactly two vehicles – this plate is already on two.
reasons.invoice_already_requested: The invoice for this contract was already requested on {{date}}.
reasons.invoice_plate_vehicle_unknown: The vehicle of this contract has no vehicle record a licence plate could be recorded on. Request the invoice without a plate and record the plate on the vehicle afterwards.
reasons.number_pattern_invalid: The pattern is not valid: exactly one {counter:N} (N from 1 to 9), {year} and {location_code} at most once, otherwise only letters, digits and - / . _
reasons.number_pattern_too_long: A number following this pattern would be longer than 16 characters.
reasons.number_pattern_location_unavailable: This document type does not know its location yet; its pattern cannot use {location_code}.
reasons.number_pattern_location_code_missing: No location of your business has a code for {location_code}. Record a location code first.
reasons.number_pattern_reset_needs_year: A range that starts again every year needs {year} in its pattern — otherwise a number would be handed out twice.
reasons.number_range_start_out_of_range: The start value does not fit the counter's digits.
reasons.number_range_frozen: This number range has handed out numbers already and is frozen. Only Nexotec support can still change it.
reasons.number_range_reason_required: A change to a frozen number range needs a reason.
reasons.number_range_exhausted: The number range has no number left for its counter's digits. Please contact support.
reasons.number_location_code_missing: This number range prints the location code, and the document names no location with a code.
reasons.number_range_counter_too_short: This pattern's counter has too few digits for the range's next number. Choose more digits for {counter:N}.
reasons.purchase_already_booked: The purchase of this vehicle is already booked. Cancel it before booking it again.
reasons.purchase_not_booked: No purchase is booked for this vehicle, so there is nothing to cancel.
reasons.purchase_storno_left_stock: This vehicle has already left stock. Its purchase can no longer be cancelled.
reasons.purchase_storno_invoice_requested: The invoice for contract {{contractNumber}} has already been requested. The purchase can no longer be cancelled.
reasons.source_ref_reserved: This reference is reserved for the purchase and its cancellation.
reasons.storno_return_not_trade_in: Only a trade-in can go back to its customer.
reasons.trade_in_vin_differs: This VIN is not the one the contract holds for the trade-in. If the contract's VIN is wrong, use «Assign configuration» to give the vehicle a configuration with the correct VIN – if it already has one, enter the VIN there with «Edit configuration». The configuration's VIN then applies.
reasons.vehicle_merge_in_progress: This vehicle is being merged with another record right now. Please try again in a moment.
reasons.valuation_names_no_car: A valuation names its car: VIN, make and model are required.
reasons.trade_in_valuation_names_no_car: This valuation names no car with a VIN that can be taken in trade.
reasons.catalogue_filter_value_unknown: The provider does not know this filter value.
reasons.catalogue_scope_required: Choose a brand or a model group first — the catalogue is never queried whole.
reasons.sort_field_unknown: The catalogue cannot be sorted by this field.
reasons.vehicle_kind_unknown_to_provider: The provider does not know this vehicle kind.
reasons.catalogue_scope_invalid: The brand or model group is not a valid name.
reasons.not_entitled: This request is not in the contract with the provider.
reasons.provider_unavailable: The provider is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
reasons.provider_quote_required: An auto-i-dat value comes from the provider — use «Get valuation from auto-i-dat» first.
reasons.provider_quote_mismatch: This auto-i-dat valuation belongs to another configuration.
reasons.provider_quote_stale: The first registration or the mileage differ from the auto-i-dat valuation. Please get it again.
reasons.provider_quote_inputs_missing: The auto-i-dat valuation needs the first registration and the mileage.
reasons.provider_not_configured: The auto-i-dat connection is not fully set up — check it under Integrations in the business administration.
reasons.secrets_backend_failed: The secure credential store did not carry out the request — nothing was saved. Please try again later; if the error persists, tell Nexotec support.
reasons.secret_slot_not_used_by_provider: This provider does not use this credential — it was not saved.
reasons.secret_store_not_configured: No secure credential store is set up for this deployment — nothing was saved. This is not caused by what you entered: please tell Nexotec support.
reasons.vehicle_not_changed: The stock vehicle has not changed since the price was built.
reasons.vin_belongs_to_other_vehicle: This VIN already belongs to vehicle {{vehicleNumber}} in the vehicle records. If it is the same car, Nexotec support merges the two.
reasons.vin_correction_left_stock: Not possible: the vehicle has left stock.
reasons.vin_correction_needs_vehicle: This vehicle has not been bought yet — its VIN is corrected in the configuration.
reasons.vin_unchanged: That is already this vehicle's VIN.
reasons.vehicle_vin_changed: The VIN in the vehicle record has changed meanwhile. Please reload and try again.
reasons.vehicle_merged: The vehicle was merged with another in the vehicle records. Please reload.
reasons.provider_has_no_captions: This provider has no vocabulary to fetch.
